## Purpose
Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation
Describe the checks performed and their results. Add screenshots for interface changes.

## Review checklist
- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests are included for new behavior or bug fixes, or the reason is explained.
- [ ] Formatting and automated checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private measurements, or local databases are included.
- [ ] Hardware-facing changes were validated in simulation; failure handling is explained.

## Hardware impact
Describe any effect on commands, state feedback, acquisition, or connection-loss handling. Write "None" if not applicable.
